title: Electrical Project Manager
desc:
Who We Are?
Founded in 1993, Rönesans Holding operates today as a main contractor and investor across a wide geography spanning Türkiye, Europe, Central Asia, and Africa, with activities in construction, real estate, energy, industrial facilities, and healthcare.
With more than 40,000 employees and a global team representing over 60 nationalities, Rönesans ranks among the world’s largest contracting companies and continues to deliver innovative engineering projects on a global scale, driven by its vision of building a sustainable future.
What You’ll Do?
Manage the project from initiation and planning through execution, commissioning, and final handover.
Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, resource plans, and procurement schedules.
Coordinate engineering, procurement, site teams, suppliers, and subcontractors to ensure timely delivery.
Monitor progress, manage project risks, resolve interface issues, and implement corrective actions.
Control scope changes and maintain records of decisions, approvals, and contractual correspondence.
Prepare regular progress reports covering schedule, cost, technical issues, risks, and required decisions.
Coordinate the preparation, review, and approval of designs, calculations, drawings, equipment specifications, and technical submissions.
Oversee technical interfaces between overhead lines, GIS, MV switchgear, protection and control, cables, earthing, and associated civil works.
Ensure engineering deliverables meet contractual requirements, applicable standards, and utility and authority requirements.
Manage technical queries and coordinate timely resolution of design and site issues.
Coordinate equipment and material procurement in line with technical requirements and project milestones.
Support technical bid evaluations, supplier selection, and purchase order specifications.
Monitor vendor drawings, manufacturing progress, inspections, factory acceptance tests, and deliveries.
Manage long-lead items and resolve technical or delivery issues with suppliers.
Coordinate subcontractor scope definition, technical evaluation, mobilization, and execution.
Monitor subcontractor performance against schedule, quality, safety, and contractual obligations.
Coordinate work interfaces and support the resolution of site constraints and construction issues.
Review progress claims, variations, and completion records with the relevant commercial and site teams.
Act as the primary project representative and single point of contact for external stakeholders.
Coordinate permits, approvals, inspections, utility interfaces, and other required submissions.
Lead project coordination meetings, document commitments, and follow up on outstanding actions.
Maintain effective working relationships with clients, government organizations, utilities, consultants, and other relevant parties.
Coordinate inspection, testing, commissioning, and energization activities with authorized parties.
Ensure readiness reviews, acceptance requirements, and outstanding defects are addressed.
Manage the submission of as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, test records, and handover documentation.
Clear communication and effective stakeholder management.
Strong leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams and manage competing priorities.
Sound technical judgment and a proactive approach to resolving issues.
Accountability for project commitments and timely escalation of risks.
Delivery against agreed project milestones and budget.
Timely engineering approvals, procurement, and equipment deliveries.
Effective subcontractor performance and stakeholder coordination.
Compliance with safety, quality, and contractual requirements.
Successful commissioning, acceptance, and final handover.
What We Expect from You?
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
Demonstrated project management experience on electrical infrastructure or power system projects.
Relevant technical experience with overhead lines, gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), and MV switchgear systems.
Experience coordinating engineering, procurement, subcontractors, and site execution.
Experience dealing with government authorities, utilities, and statutory approval processes.
Strong understanding of contracts, project scheduling, cost control, risk management, and change management.
Familiarity with applicable electrical standards, safety requirements, and quality procedures.
Professional engineering registration and/or PMP certification would be an advantage.
Proficiency in project planning tools, such as Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project, and standard reporting software.
What We Offer?
Performance-based bonus practices that recognize and reward success
Comprehensive benefits and employee support programs
Private Health Insurance benefits designed to support employee health and well-being
Training and development programs that foster professional and personal growth
Our Diversity and Equality Statement
Rönesans Holding is among the signatories of the United Nations Global Compact, which calls on companies to align their strategies and operations with universal principles on human rights, labor, environment and anti-corruption, and to take actions that advance societal goals. Rönesans Holding adopts the universally accepted principles based on the declarations recognized within the framework of the United Nations Global Compact.
Rönesans Holding is an employer that aims to ensure equality in its human resources practices by upholding transparent and ethical values, without compromising its core principles of integrity, competitiveness and innovation.
All applications are evaluated based on equal opportunity, regardless of gender, language, religion, race or ethnic origin, and no discrimination is applied.
